g.text: "Claude on AWS": two products, one exception
Billing through AWS doesn't mean AWS processes your data. Ask one question: who runs the inference that sees the prompt?
Your app, in your AWS account (IAM, SigV4, CloudTrail)
AWS, plus a copy to Anthropic
AWS processes billing (CCUs) and identity only
Why pick Claude Platform on AWS anyway: the full Claude API on day one (Skills, code execution, web search, batches, Managed Agents), billed on the AWS invoice.
Why pick Bedrock: AWS as the only data processor, AU residency, and AWS compliance programs. Our read: ANZ regulated customers usually land here.
